title: My School Day
text: I am Tom. I get up at seven o'clock every morning. I have bread and milk for breakfast. Then I walk to school with my sister. Our school is near the park. My first lesson is English at eight thirty. I like English because my teacher tells funny stories. At noon I eat rice and vegetables in the school dining room. School finishes at four o'clock. After school, I play football with my friends.

questions.prompt: What time does Tom get up?
questions.answer: At seven o'clock / 7:00 / seven o'clock / seven

questions.evidence: Then I walk to school with my sister.
